blocks.text: Standard deviation naapti hai ke data mean ke gird kitna bikhra hai. Kam standard deviation ka matlab data mean ke gird ghana hai; zyada ka matlab phaila hai; sifar ke qareeb qeemat ka matlab nuqte mean ke bohat qareeb hain. Hayatiyat mein yeh paudon ki barhne ki raftaar ya enzymes ki miqdar jaise naap ka farq jaanchne ke liye use hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Do surkh ghanti numa (bell-shaped) curves. Curve (a) chaura aur neecha, curve (b) tang aur ooncha. Har aik mein hari lakeer chooti par mean (mu) dikhati hai aur doosri hari lakeer aik standard deviation (sigma) door; un ke darmiyan sigma ka do-rukha teer. Neeche: a) phaila hua curve, zyada standard deviation; b) mean ke gird ghana curve, kam standard deviation.
blocks.caption: Normal curves: (a) zyada phaila, zyada standard deviation; (b) mean ke gird ghana, kam standard deviation (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono curves mein sigma ka teer dekhein: (a) mein mean se aik SD ka faasla bara hai, is liye data door tak phaila hai; (b) mein yeh faasla chhota hai, is liye qeematein mean ke qareeb jama hain aur curve ooncha aur tang hai.

Formula: standard deviation (sigma) = [(xi - mu) ke murabbon ka jama / N] ka jazr, jahan xi har data nuqta, mu mean aur N data nuqton ki tadaad hai. Qadam: mean nikalein; har qeemat se use tafreeq karein; har inhiraaf ka murabba lein; murabbon ki ausat lein (yeh variance hai); jazr lein.

blocks.caption: Nau paudon ki unchai ki standard deviation (kitab ki misaal)

blocks.text: Variance = 784 / 9 = 87.11, aur standard deviation = 87.11 ka jazr = 9.33 cm.

blocks.prompt: Paudon ke do set ki ausat unchai aik hai. Set X ki SD 2 cm aur set Y ki 9 cm hai. Kaun sa set zyada yaksan hai?
blocks.explanation: Set X: kam standard deviation ka matlab us ki unchaiyan mean ke zyada qareeb hain.

items: SD = mean se inhiraaf ke murabbon ki ausat ka jazr.
Paudon ki misaal: mean 75 cm, variance 87.11, SD 9.33 cm.
Kam SD: ghana data; zyada SD: phaila data.
